12	/**
13	 * For preferences with dependencies and multiple use case,
14	 * this class can be used to reduce the lines of code.
15	 */
16	object DependentPreferenceHelper {
17	    /**
18	     * Option `Resume playback` depends on `Watch history`, this method can be used to retrieve if
19	     * `Resume playback` and its dependencies are all enabled.
20	     *
21	     * @param context the Android context
22	     * @return returns true if `Resume playback` and `Watch history` are both enabled
23	     */
24	    @JvmStatic
25	    fun getResumePlaybackEnabled(context: Context): Boolean {
26	        val prefs = PreferenceManager.getDefaultSharedPreferences(context)
27	
28	        return prefs.getBoolean(context.getString(R.string.enable_watch_history_key), true) &&
29	            prefs.getBoolean(context.getString(R.string.enable_playback_resume_key), true)
30	    }
31	
32	    /**
33	     * Option `Position in lists` depends on `Watch history`, this method can be used to retrieve if
34	     * `Position in lists` and its dependencies are all enabled.
35	     *
36	     * @param context the Android context
37	     * @return returns true if `Positions in lists` and `Watch history` are both enabled
38	     */
39	    @JvmStatic
40	    fun getPositionsInListsEnabled(context: Context): Boolean {
41	        val prefs = PreferenceManager.getDefaultSharedPreferences(context)
42	
43	        return prefs.getBoolean(context.getString(R.string.enable_watch_history_key), true) &&
44	            prefs.getBoolean(context.getString(R.string.enable_playback_state_lists_key), true)

1	package org.schabi.newpipe.settings.notifications
2	
3	import android.content.Context
4	import android.os.Bundle
5	import android.view.LayoutInflater
6	import android.view.Menu
7	import android.view.MenuInflater
8	import android.view.MenuItem
9	import android.view.View
10	import android.view.ViewGroup
11	import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
12	import io.reactivex.rxjava3.android.schedulers.AndroidSchedulers
13	import io.reactivex.rxjava3.disposables.CompositeDisposable
14	import io.reactivex.rxjava3.disposables.Disposable
15	import io.reactivex.rxjava3.schedulers.Schedulers
16	import org.schabi.newpipe.R
17	import org.schabi.newpipe.database.subscription.NotificationMode
18	import org.schabi.newpipe.databinding.FragmentChannelsNotificationsBinding
19	import org.schabi.newpipe.local.subscription.SubscriptionManager
20	
21	/**
22	 * [NotificationModeConfigFragment] is a settings fragment
23	 * which allows changing the [NotificationMode] of all subscribed channels.
24	 * The [NotificationMode] can either be changed one by one or toggled for all channels.
25	 */
26	class NotificationModeConfigFragment : Fragment() {
27	    private var _binding: FragmentChannelsNotificationsBinding? = null
28	    private val binding get() = _binding!!
29	
30	    private val disposables = CompositeDisposable()
31	    private var loader: Disposable? = null
32	    private lateinit var adapter: NotificationModeConfigAdapter
33	    private lateinit var subscriptionManager: SubscriptionManager
34	
35	    override fun onAttach(context: Context) {
36	        super.onAttach(context)
37	        subscriptionManager = SubscriptionManager(context)
38	    }
39	
40	    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
41	        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
42	        setHasOptionsMenu(true)
43	    }
44	
45	    override fun onCreateView(
46	        inflater: LayoutInflater,
47	        container: ViewGroup?,
48	        savedInstanceState: Bundle?
49	    ): View {
50	        _binding = FragmentChannelsNotificationsBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false)
51	        return binding.root
52	    }
53	
54	    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
55	        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)
56	        adapter = NotificationModeConfigAdapter { position, mode ->
57	            // Notification mode has been changed via the UI.
58	            // Now change it in the database.
59	            updateNotificationMode(adapter.currentList[position], mode)
60	        }
61	        binding.recyclerView.adapter = adapter
62	        loader?.dispose()
63	        loader = subscriptionManager.subscriptions()
64	            .observeOn(AndroidSchedulers.mainThread())
65	            .subscribe(adapter::update)
66	    }
67	
68	    override fun onDestroyView() {
69	        loader?.dispose()
70	        loader = null
71	        _binding = null
72	        super.onDestroyView()
73	    }
74	
75	    override fun onDestroy() {
76	        disposables.dispose()
77	        super.onDestroy()
78	    }
79	
80	    override fun onCreateOptionsMenu(menu: Menu, inflater: MenuInflater) {
81	        super.onCreateOptionsMenu(menu, inflater)
82	        inflater.inflate(R.menu.menu_notifications_channels, menu)
83	    }
84	
85	    override fun onOptionsItemSelected(item: MenuItem): Boolean {
86	        return when (item.itemId) {
87	            R.id.action_toggle_all -> {
88	                toggleAll()
89	                true
90	            }
91	
92	            else -> super.onOptionsItemSelected(item)
93	        }
94	    }
95	
96	    private fun toggleAll() {
97	        val mode = adapter.currentList.firstOrNull()?.notificationMode ?: return
98	        val newMode = when (mode) {
99	            NotificationMode.DISABLED -> NotificationMode.ENABLED
100	            else -> NotificationMode.DISABLED
101	        }
102	        adapter.currentList.forEach { updateNotificationMode(it, newMode) }
103	    }
104	
105	    private fun updateNotificationMode(item: SubscriptionItem, @NotificationMode mode: Int) {
106	        disposables.add(
107	            subscriptionManager.updateNotificationMode(item.serviceId, item.url, mode)
108	                .subscribeOn(Schedulers.io())
109	                .subscribe()
110	        )
111	    }
112	}

7	import androidx.lifecycle.MutableLiveData
8	import com.xwray.groupie.Group
9	import io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Flowable
10	import io.reactivex.rxjava3.processors.BehaviorProcessor
11	import io.reactivex.rxjava3.schedulers.Schedulers
12	import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
13	import org.schabi.newpipe.info_list.ItemViewMode
14	import org.schabi.newpipe.local.feed.FeedDatabaseManager
15	import org.schabi.newpipe.local.subscription.item.ChannelItem
16	import org.schabi.newpipe.local.subscription.item.FeedGroupCardGridItem
17	import org.schabi.newpipe.local.subscription.item.FeedGroupCardItem
18	import org.schabi.newpipe.util.DEFAULT_THROTTLE_TIMEOUT
19	import org.schabi.newpipe.util.ThemeHelper.getItemViewMode
20	
21	class SubscriptionViewModel(application: Application) : AndroidViewModel(application) {
22	    private var feedDatabaseManager: FeedDatabaseManager = FeedDatabaseManager(application)
23	    private var subscriptionManager = SubscriptionManager(application)
24	
25	    // true -> list view, false -> grid view
26	    private val listViewMode = BehaviorProcessor.createDefault(
27	        !shouldUseGridForSubscription(application)
28	    )
29	    private val listViewModeFlowable = listViewMode.distinctUntilChanged()
30	
31	    private val mutableStateLiveData = MutableLiveData<SubscriptionState>()
32	    private val mutableFeedGroupsLiveData = MutableLiveData<Pair<List<Group>, Boolean>>()
33	    val stateLiveData: LiveData<SubscriptionState> = mutableStateLiveData
34	    val feedGroupsLiveData: LiveData<Pair<List<Group>, Boolean>> = mutableFeedGroupsLiveData
35	
36	    private var feedGroupItemsDisposable = Flowable
37	        .combineLatest(
38	            feedDatabaseManager.groups(),
39	            listViewModeFlowable,
40	            ::Pair
41	        )
42	        .throttleLatest(DEFAULT_THROTTLE_TIMEOUT, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
43	        .map { (feedGroups, listViewMode) ->
44	            Pair(
45	                feedGroups.map(if (listViewMode) ::FeedGroupCardItem else ::FeedGroupCardGridItem),
46	                listViewMode
47	            )
48	        }
49	        .subscribeOn(Schedulers.io())
50	        .subscribe(
51	            { mutableFeedGroupsLiveData.postValue(it) },
52	            { mutableStateLiveData.postValue(SubscriptionState.ErrorState(it)) }
53	        )
54	
55	    private var stateItemsDisposable = subscriptionManager.subscriptions()
56	        .throttleLatest(DEFAULT_THROTTLE_TIMEOUT, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
57	        .map { it.map { entity -> ChannelItem(entity.toChannelInfoItem(), entity.uid, ChannelItem.ItemVersion.MINI) } }
58	        .subscribeOn(Schedulers.io())
59	        .subscribe(
60	            { mutableStateLiveData.postValue(SubscriptionState.LoadedState(it)) },
61	            { mutableStateLiveData.postValue(SubscriptionState.ErrorState(it)) }
62	        )
63	
64	    override fun onCleared() {
65	        super.onCleared()
66	        stateItemsDisposable.dispose()
67	        feedGroupItemsDisposable.dispose()
68	    }
69	
70	    fun setListViewMode(newListViewMode: Boolean) {
71	        listViewMode.onNext(newListViewMode)
72	    }
73	
74	    fun getListViewMode(): Boolean {
75	        return listViewMode.value ?: true
76	    }
77	
78	    sealed class SubscriptionState {
79	        data class LoadedState(val subscriptions: List<Group>) : SubscriptionState()
80	        data class ErrorState(val error: Throwable? = null) : SubscriptionState()
81	    }
82	
83	    companion object {
84	
85	        /**
86	         * Returns whether to use GridLayout mode for Subscription Fragment.
87	         *
88	         * ### Current mapping:
89	         *
90	         *  | ItemViewMode | ItemVersion | Span count |
91	         *  |---|---|---|
92	         *  | AUTO | MINI | 1 |
93	         *  | LIST | MINI | 1 |
94	         *  | CARD | GRID | > 1 (ThemeHelper defined) |
95	         *  | GRID | GRID | > 1 (ThemeHelper defined) |
96	         *
97	         *  @see [SubscriptionViewModel.shouldUseGridForSubscription] to modify Layout Manager
98	         */
99	        fun shouldUseGridForSubscription(context: Context): Boolean {
100	            val itemViewMode = getItemViewMode(context)
101	            return itemViewMode == ItemViewMode.GRID || itemViewMode == ItemViewMode.CARD
102	        }
103	    }
104	}

20	class FeedGroupDialogViewModel(
21	    applicationContext: Context,
22	    private val groupId: Long = FeedGroupEntity.GROUP_ALL_ID,
23	    initialQuery: String = "",
24	    initialShowOnlyUngrouped: Boolean = false
25	) : ViewModel() {
26	
27	    private var feedDatabaseManager: FeedDatabaseManager = FeedDatabaseManager(applicationContext)
28	    private var subscriptionManager = SubscriptionManager(applicationContext)
29	
30	    private var filterSubscriptions = BehaviorProcessor.create<String>()
31	    private var toggleShowOnlyUngrouped = BehaviorProcessor.create<Boolean>()
32	
33	    private var subscriptionsFlowable = Flowable
34	        .combineLatest(
35	            filterSubscriptions.startWithItem(initialQuery),
36	            toggleShowOnlyUngrouped.startWithItem(initialShowOnlyUngrouped)
37	        ) { t1: String, t2: Boolean -> Filter(t1, t2) }
38	        .distinctUntilChanged()
39	        .switchMap { (query, showOnlyUngrouped) ->
40	            subscriptionManager.getSubscriptions(groupId, query, showOnlyUngrouped)
41	        }.map { list -> list.map { PickerSubscriptionItem(it) } }
42	
43	    private val mutableGroupLiveData = MutableLiveData<FeedGroupEntity>()
44	    private val mutableSubscriptionsLiveData = MutableLiveData<Pair<List<PickerSubscriptionItem>, Set<Long>>>()
45	    private val mutableDialogEventLiveData = MutableLiveData<DialogEvent>()
46	    val groupLiveData: LiveData<FeedGroupEntity> = mutableGroupLiveData
47	    val subscriptionsLiveData: LiveData<Pair<List<PickerSubscriptionItem>, Set<Long>>> = mutableSubscriptionsLiveData
48	    val dialogEventLiveData: LiveData<DialogEvent> = mutableDialogEventLiveData
49	
50	    private var actionProcessingDisposable: Disposable? = null
51	
52	    private var feedGroupDisposable = feedDatabaseManager.getGroup(groupId)
53	        .subscribeOn(Schedulers.io())
54	        .subscribe(mutableGroupLiveData::postValue)
55	
56	    private var subscriptionsDisposable = Flowable
57	        .combineLatest(
58	            subscriptionsFlowable,
59	            feedDatabaseManager.subscriptionIdsForGroup(groupId)
60	        ) { t1: List<PickerSubscriptionItem>, t2: List<Long> -> t1 to t2.toSet() }
61	        .subscribeOn(Schedulers.io())
62	        .subscribe(mutableSubscriptionsLiveData::postValue)
63	
64	    override fun onCleared() {
65	        super.onCleared()
66	        actionProcessingDisposable?.dispose()
67	        subscriptionsDisposable.dispose()
68	        feedGroupDisposable.dispose()
69	    }
70	
71	    fun createGroup(name: String, selectedIcon: FeedGroupIcon, selectedSubscriptions: Set<Long>) {
72	        doAction(
73	            feedDatabaseManager.createGroup(name, selectedIcon)
74	                .flatMapCompletable {
75	                    feedDatabaseManager.updateSubscriptionsForGroup(it, selectedSubscriptions.toList())
76	                }
77	        )
78	    }
79	
80	    fun updateGroup(name: String, selectedIcon: FeedGroupIcon, selectedSubscriptions: Set<Long>, sortOrder: Long) {
81	        doAction(
82	            feedDatabaseManager.updateSubscriptionsForGroup(groupId, selectedSubscriptions.toList())
83	                .andThen(feedDatabaseManager.updateGroup(FeedGroupEntity(groupId, name, selectedIcon, sortOrder)))
84	        )
85	    }
86	
87	    fun deleteGroup() {
88	        doAction(feedDatabaseManager.deleteGroup(groupId))
89	    }
90	
91	    private fun doAction(completable: Completable) {
92	        if (actionProcessingDisposable == null) {
93	            mutableDialogEventLiveData.value = DialogEvent.ProcessingEvent
94	
95	            actionProcessingDisposable = completable
96	                .subscribeOn(Schedulers.io())
97	                .subscribe { mutableDialogEventLiveData.postValue(DialogEvent.SuccessEvent) }
98	        }
99	    }
100	
101	    fun filterSubscriptionsBy(query: String) {
102	        filterSubscriptions.onNext(query)
103	    }
104	
105	    fun clearSubscriptionsFilter() {
106	        filterSubscriptions.onNext("")
107	    }
108	
109	    fun toggleShowOnlyUngrouped(showOnlyUngrouped: Boolean) {
110	        toggleShowOnlyUngrouped.onNext(showOnlyUngrouped)
111	    }
112	
113	    sealed class DialogEvent {
114	        data object ProcessingEvent : DialogEvent()
115	        data object SuccessEvent : DialogEvent()
116	    }
117	
118	    data class Filter(val query: String, val showOnlyUngrouped: Boolean)
119	
120	    companion object {
121	        fun getFactory(
122	            context: Context,
123	            groupId: Long,
124	            initialQuery: String,
125	            initialShowOnlyUngrouped: Boolean
126	        ) = viewModelFactory {
127	            initializer {
128	                FeedGroupDialogViewModel(
129	                    context.applicationContext,
130	                    groupId,
131	                    initialQuery,
132	                    initialShowOnlyUngrouped
133	                )
134	            }
135	        }
136	    }
137	}

Committed as `cbdf5af23`. Here's what changed:

- **`FeedGroupDialogViewModel.kt`**: Replaced `{ t1: String, t2: Boolean -> Filter(t1, t2) }` with the constructor reference `::Filter`; renamed opaque `t1`/`t2` in the second `combineLatest` to `subscriptions`/`ids`.
- **`FeedGroupReorderDialogViewModel.kt`**: `object` → `data object` for `ProcessingEvent` and `SuccessEvent`, matching how the sibling `FeedGroupDialogViewModel` already defines the same pattern.
- **`LocalPlaylistManager.kt`**: All three `[0]` index accesses → `.first()`; `if (name != null) { playlist.name = name }` → `name?.let { playlist.name = it }`; `.map { count -> count > 0 }` → `.map { it > 0 }`.
- **`SubscriptionViewModel.kt`**: `== GRID || == CARD` membership test → `in setOf(GRID, CARD)`; `getListViewMode` block body → expression function.
